How to Appeal a Denied Insurance Claim in India (2026 Guide)

By Hari Kotian | Published on 2026-07-25

A claim rejection is not the end of the road. Whether it’s a life insurance death claim, a health insurance hospitalization bill, or a motor insurance repair cost, you have legal recourse if you believe your claim was wrongly denied. Here is the 5-step process to fight back and recover your rightful benefits.

Important First Step

Before doing anything, request the official Rejection Letter from your insurer. It must state the specific reason for denial (e.g., non-disclosure, waiting period, lack of documentation). Without this letter, you cannot build your case.

The 5-Step Claim Recovery Funnel

  1. 1. Analyze the Rejection

    Compare the reason provided in the rejection letter against your policy document. Did you miss a disclosure? Was it a technical paperwork issue? Many rejections are based on administrative errors, not lack of coverage.

  2. 2. Internal Grievance Cell

    Every insurance company is mandated by IRDAI to have a Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO). Submit a formal appeal to them. You must receive a response within 15 days.

  3. 3. IRDAI Bima Bharosa Portal

    If the GRO fails to resolve your issue or provides an unsatisfactory answer, register your complaint on the IRDAI Bima Bharosa Portal. This forces the insurer to re-examine the file at a higher internal level.

  4. 4. Insurance Ombudsman

    If you still get no justice, approach the Insurance Ombudsman in your region. This is a quasi-judicial body specifically for resolving consumer-insurer disputes. The decision is binding on the insurer.

  5. 5. Consumer Forum

    As a last resort, you can approach the Consumer Dispute Redressal Commission. Note that this can be a longer process, so Ombudsman is usually preferred.
